title: ECC WP3: mirror ECC's development workflow through OMP
description: Mirror ECC's development workflow through OMP's existing intake, plan, execute, summary and done path, as specified in docs/programme/ECC-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC.md §6 (WP3), with the adoption map in §5 and the rollout order and stop conditions in §8.
acceptance_criteria: With the pack installed, /intake, /plan, /execute, /summary and /done remain native OMP commands and are not replaced or shadowed
Workflow guidance is delivered as rulebook rules read via rule://, and no prompt carries a full rule body
Every tool and path named by an adopted skill resolves in OMP
The pack adds no mandatory reviewer, coverage rule, commit, push or approval step
Reuse records live in the existing intake and plan records; no second backlog exists
A trial of 5-10 tasks (Python/PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Rust, and one non-OMP repo; models fixed) records results, interventions, usage and workflow growth

title: ECC WP7: adapt learning and lifecycle into existing OMP paths
description: Adapt ECC's learning and lifecycle features into existing OMP paths, as specified in docs/programme/ECC-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC.md §6 (WP7), with the adoption map in §5 and rollout and stop conditions in §8. 7A and 7B are qualified separately.
acceptance_criteria: Lesson records are append-only and hold trigger, action, scope, source task, evidence, outcomes for and against, review state and provenance
Optional lessons are capped by count and by tokens; mandatory criteria are never counted against the caps
Rejected or contradicted lessons are never promoted, and promotion requires owner approval
No second memory authority and no observer daemon exists
Event contracts are inventoried before any helper is wired to them
Compaction and restart recovery keep scope and cancellation intact
When an optional helper fails, it yields a diagnosis and the native operation continues
No model loop runs unless requested
Compiled OMP never self-launches as a hook
